_meta.description: Creature stat blocks for VTT miniatures

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.desc: The table is {@condition incapacitated} while in the area of an {@spell antimagic field}. If targeted by {@spell dispel magic}, the table must succeed on a {@save Con 12} saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute.

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If the table moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the table remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal table.

actions.name: Ram
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: {@damage 2d8 + 4} bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.desc: The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: {@damage 1d6 + 2} slashing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: {@hit 4} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: {@damage 1d6 + 2} piercing damage.

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: {@damage 1d12 + 3} slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: {@damage 1d6 + 3} piercing damage.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: {@damage 2d8 + 4} bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: {@damage 2d6 + 4} piercing damage.
